newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hong Leong takes over Boulevard Hotel operations.
newsitem.headline: Hong Leong takes over Boulevard Hotel operations.

text.p: Hong Leong Group said on Friday it was formally taking over operations of Singapore's 520-room Boulevard Hotel.

The group said in a statement it would carry on the business under the "Boulevard Hotel" until its redevelopment plans receive formal approval. It intends to redevelop the hotel site into an upmarket condominium project.

Hong Leong, together with City Developments Ltd and Lea Investments Pte Ltd, bought the Boulevard Hotel site from Hotel Malaysia Ltd on April 29, 1997 for Singapore $410 million. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
